title: Nexgen OS country pack, version 1
description: A pack is the few values a country decides that a function of the model reads. This schema describes every file of packs/<cc>/: the manifest pack.json (the root of this schema, which carries the identity of the country) and the section files identifiers.json, sources.json, grid.json and defaults.json ($defs/identifiers_file, $defs/sources_file, $defs/grid_file, $defs/defaults_file). Nothing here is executable: there is no expression, no script, no hook, and there will not be one. A value is a value, a unit and a reference. Nothing is ever deleted from a pack: a value that stops holding gets a valid_to and the value that replaces it is a new row. `nexgen-os pack build <cc>` compiles a pack into supabase/seed/<seed_sequence>_pack_<cc>.sql; `nexgen-os pack check --all` refuses a seed that is not the exact output of its pack.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case. The folder is the same code in lower case. Immutable once published.

name.description: The country in English, as countries.name holds it.

version.description: The version of the pack, recorded in countries.pack_version. Patch: a name, a description, a reference corrected. Minor: a row added, or a validity that closes. Major: a section reshaped. Adding anything is a version.

checksum.description: Written by `nexgen-os pack build`, never by hand: the sha256 of the JSON files the seed is compiled from (this file without its checksum, then each section file). Recorded in countries.pack_checksum, so an installation can be compared to a checkout.

schema_min.description: The oldest schema version of the core (nexgen_schema_version()) whose tables this pack fills.

seed_sequence.description: The number the compiled seed carries: 12 gives supabase/seed/12_pack_<cc>.sql. Declared rather than derived, so that adding a country never renames the seed of another; immutable once published. Take the first number no pack of the checkout has taken: `nexgen-os pack check --all` refuses two packs claiming one.

modules.description: Modules whose tables the seed writes into. A pack with grid operators names `grid`; the installer refuses the pack where the module is neither asked nor installed (pack_requires_module).

sections.description: The section files this pack carries, each one <section>.json beside this file. sources and defaults are required; identifiers when the country has schemes of its own; project_kinds when its law defines frames of projects; municipalities when a value or an operator follows a municipality; grid when the pack describes energy. Every file listed exists and every JSON file present is listed.

exempt.description: Why the pack carries no golden case.

golden.description: Only for a pack that cannot carry a golden case: why. Every other pack carries packs/<cc>/golden/<case>/scenario.json and expectations.json, read by `nexgen-os pack check` and replayed by tests/golden.test.ts.

place_code.description: A region of identity.regions (ISO 3166-2), or a municipality of municipalities.json: the country code, a hyphen and its own code (FR-75056).

url_template.description: An https URL with {value} where the identifier goes.

regions.description: The regions a row is limited to, among those of identity.regions; absent or empty: the whole country.

certification.description: How much anyone has read this pack. community: proposed and checked by the toolchain; maintained: the maintainers keep it; reviewed: a named professional of the country read every value, on the date given.

reviewer.description: Who read it and in which capacity. Required when reviewed.

date.description: When it was read. Required when reviewed.

identity.description: Who the country is: what joining a project, the geocoders and the applications read. Compiled into countries and regions.

currency.description: ISO 4217: a row of currencies, the core's list or currency_details.

currency_details.description: The currency as a row of currencies, when the core's list does not hold it: added, never updated.

languages.description: BCP 47 tags of the official languages, in the order the country lists them.

time_zones.description: IANA time zones; the first is the one a participant of the country gets when its region names none.

region_level.description: The subdivision the pack's rows and places use, in English: region, province, department, state.

postal_code_pattern.description: A regular expression a postal code of the country matches, anchored.

bbox.description: The box a map opens on: west, south, east, north, in degrees (WGS 84).

municipality_scheme.description: The id scheme, declared in identifiers.json, that numbers the municipalities.

regions.description: The subdivisions at region_level, and their parents when a row or a place names one. Every region a row of the pack names is declared here.

parent.description: The region it belongs to, declared in this pack.

time_zone.description: One of identity.time_zones, when it is not the first.

names.description: Its name in other languages, by BCP 47 tag.

aliases.description: Other names it is written under: an old name, an abbreviation.

postal_prefixes.description: The first characters of the postal codes inside it.

identifiers_file.description: identifiers.json: the identifier schemes of the country. Compiled into identifier_schemes.

pattern.description: A regular expression every value matches, anchored; the same expression in Postgres and in JavaScript.

example.description: A real-looking value that matches the pattern. Checked, not stored.

source_code.description: The source whose service answers for this identifier.

icd.description: The ISO 6523 International Code Designator of a register of legal persons, when ISO 6523 lists it: the code an electronic invoice carries the identifier under, and the one Ekwo OS's pack of the country names. No check digit is validated here: that is the invoicing side's.

sources_file.description: sources.json: the registers, geocoders, data hubs, statistics and published texts of the country, as data. Compiled into sources. A value of the pack cites one of these by its code.

kind.description: api: queried live; file: a downloaded dataset; registry: an official register; text: a published text a value is read from (a law, an operator's grid code, a statistic).

url.description: Where the source is served or the text is published.

auth.description: How a connector authenticates; none when absent. The secret itself is never in a pack.

license.description: The licence, by its usual name or SPDX identifier.

redistributable.description: Whether what is fetched may be passed on to others.

retention_days.description: How long the licence lets an installation keep what it fetched; absent: for ever.

grid_file.description: grid.json: who runs the grid, its voltage levels and the connection thresholds a calculation reads. Operators are compiled into the operator table of the grid module; voltage levels and thresholds into defaults, as any other value.

thresholds.description: Connection thresholds, written as defaults rows: a maximum power per voltage level, the power above which a connection needs a study.

support_schemes.description: The support schemes of the country, compiled into grid.support_schemes: who is eligible, for how long, and the dated obligation to stop at negative prices. The tariff is the contract's, never the pack's.

allocation.description: How a contract is awarded; absent: open_window.

device_types.description: The device types eligible, and the types refining them; absent: any.

threshold_kw.description: A producer of this rated power or more stops, or loses its support, while the market price is negative.

source_code.description: The text that sets the rule, when it is not the scheme's own.

kind.description: tso: transmission; dso: distribution; island: a zone not connected to the main grid.

coverage.description: What it covers, in plain words, when regions do not say it all.

data_hub_url.description: Where a third party reads meter data with the customer's consent.

meter_data.description: How the operator's hub publishes meter data, read by its connectors: never written in their code.

sources.description: The sources that read the hub, in the order an installation tries them.

time_zone.description: The IANA zone the hub's files date their steps in when they carry no offset.

quality_codes.description: The hub's quality letters mapped to series_values.quality (0 measured, 1 estimated, 2 substituted, 3 missing, 100 and up the pack's own); the key missing for a step the file does not carry, none for a value without a letter.

history_months.description: How far back the hub serves readings.

steps.description: The steps of its load curves, ISO 8601 durations.

identifier_scheme.description: The id scheme of the metering points it issues.

eic_code.description: Its Energy Identification Code as a market party (ENTSO-E EIC).

municipalities.description: The municipalities it serves when it serves part of a region only, declared in municipalities.json.

identifier_prefixes.description: The prefixes of the metering point identifiers it issues, when its numbering says who issued a point; grid.operator_of() takes the longest that matches.

voltage_levels.description: The voltage levels of the country, compiled into one defaults row of the property voltage_levels, in kilovolts.

min_kv.description: Nominal voltage above which a connection belongs to this level, excluded.

max_kv.description: Nominal voltage up to which it does, included.

project_kinds_file.description: project_kinds.json: the frames of projects the law of the country defines (a collective self-consumption operation, a renewable energy community), each refining a generic kind of the core and citing its text. Compiled into project_kinds.

name.description: The name the law gives it.

parent.description: The generic kind of the core it refines: collective_self_consumption, energy_community…

source_code.description: The text that defines it, declared in sources.json.

municipalities_file.description: municipalities.json: the municipalities of the country a value or an operator follows, each under its region, with its density class where the country publishes a density grid. Compiled into regions (kind municipality, code CC-<code>) and, for the classes, into defaults rows of the property density_class. A pack may list a subset; the full list is loaded the same way, from a larger file of the same shape or by a connector writing the same rows.

source_code.description: The register the list was read from, declared in sources.json.

density_classes.description: The classes of the density grid of the country, and where the class of each municipality was read.

code.description: The country's own code, a value of identity.municipality_scheme.

parent.description: The region of identity.regions it is part of.

defaults_file.description: defaults.json: the country and region values of the cascade parameter_of() resolves. Compiled into defaults.

condition.description: When a value holds, in the one shape of a condition the core checks (condition_check()) and matches (condition_matches()): every key optional, every key given must hold; {} or absent: every object. The same shape as a template of the actions module.

project_kind.description: The kind of project (a project_kinds code, the core's or this pack's) and the kinds refining it.

segment.description: The customer segment (a segments code of the core) and the segments refining it.

device_type.description: The technology (a device_types code) and the types refining it, read when the value is asked from a device.

density_class.description: The density class of the municipality, one of municipalities.json density_classes.classes.

attribute.description: An attribute of the object compared with a number; an object without the attribute is not decided.

default.description: One value, for the whole country or for one region, over one period. A value that changes is never edited: the row gets a valid_to, and the new value is a new row whose valid_from is that day. A value that holds for some objects of the place only names its condition, in the one shape of a condition (a kind of project, a segment, a technology, a density class, an attribute); parameter_of() takes the most specific row whose condition the object meets.

attribute_type.description: An attribute_types code; the database refuses an unknown one (attribute_type_unknown).

region.description: The region or the municipality the value holds in; absent: the whole country.

value.description: The value, in the attribute type's datatype. null: the country gives no single answer (it depends on the company, a contract or an option), and the reference says where that is decided.

unit.description: For a number, the unit code of the attribute type's quantity (QUDT, as quantities.unit holds it); the database refuses another (unit_mismatch). Otherwise the form of the value: ISO8601-duration, code, hours, list.

source_code.description: The source, declared in sources.json, the value was read from.

reference.description: Where in that source: the article, the table, the page.

quality.description: What kind of value it is, a word of the domain value_quality: published when the source decides it, estimated for a statistic or a model, assumed for a conventional value. Absent: published.

valid_to.description: The first day the value does not hold, as everywhere in the model: a period is [valid_from, valid_to). The row that replaces it starts that day. Absent: it still holds.
